title: Padmé Amidala
description: Senator Padmé Amidala served in the Republic Senate as the representative of Naboo. Courageous and headstrong, she fought for what she thought was right no matter the cost, and would find herself targeted by assassins when she opposed the Military Creation Act. Senator Palpatine requested Jedi protection—specifically the services of Anakin Skywalker. Together, they traveled to Naboo as refugees, but quickly found themselves drawn further into political intrigue as well as in love...
